sourceBasis: Independent generated HUD chrome studies (gpt-image-2 and the built-in image tool, no original-game input). The icon atlas takes six of the eight cells of source/nordic-icons-v4.png (record: source/generation-icons-v4.json) and the door cell of source/nordic-menu-v1.png (record: source/generation-menu-v1.json); the notification atlas takes seven of the eight objects of source/nordic-notices-v1.png (record: source/generation-notices-v1.json), whose magenta areas are a recolour key, not final colour; the surface is the retained material study. Sizes are approximations chosen for 50 px navigation art at up to 2x device pixels.
